draft.quote: The Ras Tanura oil refinery, one of Saudi Arabia’s largest and most critical energy facilities, sustained significant damage
draft.summary: The Taiwan Times reports that a Houthi attack on the Ras Tanura refinery in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province caused a fire, according to Saudi security officials. The fire forced the temporary shutdown of several processing units and disrupted output for the rest of the day, and the article says storage tanks and piping were reportedly damaged. Saudi authorities have not released an official estimate of the damage or economic cost.
